bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
base=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed
prev="$base/.releases/93cf8687677b418e4b2a04820ed3906851f03d1e/unified-stars"
test -d "$src/.git" && test -f "$base/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 63
for p in src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs src/telegram/salesPanel.mjs src/sales/pgUnifiedStarsSales.mjs; do
 test -f "$prev/$p" || exit 64
 live="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 65
 prior="$(sha256sum "$prev/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 66
 test "$live" = "$prior" || exit 67
done
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "'020_owner_update_jobs.sql'" /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs || exit 68
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "if(schema.migrations!==20)" /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs || exit 69
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "let recoveryCursor=0,recoveryInFlight=null,workerError=null;" /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs || exit 70
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "async confirmRefund(telegramTransactionId,maxPages=3)" /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgStarsLedger.mjs || exit 71
docker exec "$cid" test ! -e /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgCreatorRefundReconciler.mjs || exit 72
docker exec "$cid" test ! -e /opt/videobot/sql/021_sticker_refunds.sql || exit 73
echo STARS_REFUND_RUNTIME_BASELINE=PASS
